defensiveAbilities.name: Countered by Metal
defensiveAbilities.description: If the forest dragon takes damage from a metal item, they lose woodland stride and Vanishing Tracks until the end of their next turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fed by Water
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger The forest dragon is targeted with a water spell or effect

Effect The forest dragon gains 30 temporary Hit Points.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 27 Will Saving Throw

Animals, fungi, and plants take a -2 circumstance penalty to the save.

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon unleashes a swarm of insects that deals 10d6 Piercing Damage damage in a 30ft Cone (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save) before dispersing.

A creature that critically fails is Stunned 2 from the insects' venom; this is a poison effect.

The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Coiling Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes one claw Strike and one tail Strike in either order, each against the same target. If either Strike hits, the dragon automatically Grabs the target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(2d8+8) Bludgeoning Damage, Basic DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Woodland Stride
offensiveAbilities.description: The forest dragon ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from non-magical foliage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

cantrips.name: Know Direction
cantrips.description:
In your mind's eye, you see a path northward. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location).

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a previous home or a favorite tavern.

lv1spells.name: Pass Without Trace (Constant) (Forest Terrain Only)
lv1spells.description:
You obscure the tracks you leave behind and make it harder for others to find you. The DC of checks to Track you gains a +4 status bonus or is equal to your spell DC, whichever results in a higher DC. You can benefit from only one pass without trace spell at a time.

Heightened (2nd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to 8 hours. The spell has a range of 20 feet and an area of a 20-foot-emanation, affecting up to 10 creatures of your choice within that area.

lv2spells.name: Entangle
lv2spells.description: Plants in the area entangle creatures. The area counts as difficult terrain. Each round that a creature starts its turn in the area, it must attempt a Reflex save. On a failure, it takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until it leaves the area, and on a critical failure, it is also Immobilized for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to Escape at entangle's DC to remove these effects.

lv3spells.name: Fear (Animals, Fungi, And Plants Only)
lv3spells.description:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 3 and Fleeing for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
